description: Key aroma compounds for top cocktail ingredients. Used by cocktail-agent to justify pairings via shared volatiles.

ingredients.name: gin
ingredients.aroma_profile: Juniper-forward with citrus and floral notes

ingredients.name: vodka
ingredients.aroma_profile: Neutral carrier with minimal congeners; flavor comes from co-ingredients

ingredients.name: white rum
ingredients.aroma_profile: Light ester-driven tropical and fruity character

ingredients.name: dark rum
ingredients.aroma_profile: Rich caramel and vanilla from oak aging, with dried fruit esters

ingredients.name: bourbon
ingredients.aroma_profile: Sweet vanilla and baking spice from charred oak, with caramel undertones

ingredients.name: rye whiskey
ingredients.aroma_profile: Spicy and peppery with higher phenolic content than bourbon, drier oak character

ingredients.name: scotch
ingredients.aroma_profile: Smoky phenolics from peat, malty sweetness, fruity esters

ingredients.name: tequila
ingredients.aroma_profile: Herbaceous agave with vegetal-floral notes and light tropical esters
bridges_to: lime (limonene and citric acid are canonical bridge)

ingredients.name: mezcal
ingredients.aroma_profile: Pronounced smoke from roasted agave, with earthy and fruity ester complexity

ingredients.name: cognac
ingredients.aroma_profile: Fruity esters with oak-derived vanilla, dried fruit, and grape tannins
bridges_to: cointreau (ester and limonene overlap — Sidecar bridge)

ingredients.name: sweet vermouth
ingredients.aroma_profile: Wormwood bitterness layered with floral botanicals, caramel, and warm spice

ingredients.name: dry vermouth
ingredients.aroma_profile: Herbaceous wormwood with bright citrus peel oils and dry botanical finish
bridges_to: olive (fatty acid contrast to herbal terpenes)

ingredients.name: campari
ingredients.aroma_profile: Intensely bitter from gentian root, with supporting citrus oils and herbal complexity

ingredients.name: cointreau
ingredients.aroma_profile: Bright orange peel oil with floral sweetness and clean citrus esters

ingredients.name: maraschino liqueur
ingredients.aroma_profile: Almond-cherry kernel aroma from cherry pits, with subtle floral and spice

ingredients.name: chartreuse
ingredients.aroma_profile: Extraordinarily complex herbal terpene blend from 130 botanicals; minty, herbaceous, and warm

ingredients.name: simple syrup
ingredients.aroma_profile: Pure sweetness with no aroma compounds; serves as textural and flavor-balance baseline

ingredients.name: lime juice
ingredients.aroma_profile: Sharp citric acidity with green-floral terpenes and bright peel oils

ingredients.name: lemon juice
ingredients.aroma_profile: Bright citric acidity with dominant lemon-peel aldehyde aroma
bridges_to: honey (citral and floral volatiles — Bee's Knees bridge)

ingredients.name: grapefruit juice
ingredients.aroma_profile: Distinctively bitter from naringin, with sulfur-tinged tropical citrus and woody nootkatone

ingredients.name: orange juice
ingredients.aroma_profile: Sweet citrus with waxy aldehydes and fruity esters

ingredients.name: angostura bitters
ingredients.aroma_profile: Warm cinnamon-clove spice over gentian root bitterness with citrus highlights
bridges_to: sweet vermouth (cinnamaldehyde, bitter overlap — Manhattan bridge)

ingredients.name: egg white
ingredients.aroma_profile: No significant aroma; protein matrix creates silky foam that traps and slowly releases volatile aromas from other ingredients
bridges_to: lemon (citric acid denatures protein for stable foam — Whiskey Sour bridge)
gin (foam traps and releases linalool gradually)
bitters (aromatic dash on foam surface maximizes volatile perception)

ingredients.name: ginger
ingredients.aroma_profile: Pungent heat from gingerol with citrus-woody terpene backbone

ingredients.name: honey
ingredients.aroma_profile: Floral volatiles with caramel undertones; exact profile varies by botanical source

ingredients.name: coffee
ingredients.aroma_profile: Roasty pyrazines with caramel furans and sulfurous depth; smoky guaiacol in dark roasts
bridges_to: dark rum (furans, caramel — Espresso Martini bridge)

ingredients.name: chocolate
ingredients.aroma_profile: Bitter alkaloid base with roasty pyrazines, vanilla, and subtle floral notes

ingredients.name: coconut
ingredients.aroma_profile: Creamy lactone-dominated aroma with waxy tropical character
bridges_to: white rum (ester-lactone tropical synergy — Pina Colada bridge)

ingredients.name: pineapple
ingredients.aroma_profile: Intensely fruity ester profile with caramel furaneol sweetness; bromelain enzyme affects texture
bridges_to: white rum (ethyl butyrate — Pina Colada bridge)

ingredients.name: mint
ingredients.aroma_profile: Dominant cooling menthol sensation with sweet terpene and camphoraceous notes
